note: Endings and victories (v2 step 9). Checked at the end of every month: domination (a power holds `domination.share` of the North's capitals, its own included) and faith (a power's Devotion at least `faith.devotion` and `faith.lead` times every other's) end the game at once. Otherwise, at the end of December 1272 the lore decides: the Empire triumphant (it holds `empire.capitals` or more of the four northern great capitals), one king rules the North (one northern power holds `oneKing.capitals` or more of them), or the North holds. The player's own fate is told beside it.

faiths.nilfgaard: the Great Sun over the North

domination.title: {name} rules the North
domination.text: {name} holds the capitals of the North. Every crown that still stands, stands by its leave.

faith.title: {faith}
faith.text: {name}'s faith has won what its armies could not: temples rise in every city, and kings kneel to its priests.

empire.title: The Empire triumphant
empire.text: The black banners fly over the North's capitals. The northern kingdoms are provinces now, governed from Nilfgaard.

oneKing.title: One king rules the North
oneKing.text: {name} has united the North by the sword and thrown the Empire back across the Yaruga.

holds.title: The North holds
holds.text: The Empire is held at the Yaruga. The northern crowns endure, quarrelling, bloodied and free.

fate.won: Temeria stands at the head of the North.
fate.vassal: Temeria survives, at best, as an imperial province.
fate.fallen: Vizima is in foreign hands, and the lion's banner is folded away.
